en: Well, that's about it. I hope that made a little more sense this time.
I'm sorry. Could you explain it just one more time?
No problem. Here's how this kind of event usually goes.

A fan who is removed leaves in fear, and the fan satisfaction level drops.
Luckily, "The Remover" is also a big fan of yours.

 Use <Action:Button_L1@Handshake> to flash him a smile and he'll turn to mush and forget to do his job. You can use this to your advantage by smiling at the right time.
Yes, I think I'm all set. Thank you.

That was so much fun!
Great job, Haruka-san!
Thank you, Uda-san.

Yes, I really enjoyed getting the chance to meet and talk to the fans directly.
I'm glad to hear it! We're all very pleased with how today turned out.
So, I've already discussed your compensation with your agency.
Okay, thank you.
But I wanted to add in a little something extra from me.
Really!? Are you sure?
Absolutely! It's just a small thank-you for all your hard work.
Oh, thank you so much!
You got a <Color:8>Club Sandwich<Color:Default>.

Good job, Haruka-san!

I look forward to our next event together!

I will. I promise!

So young, yet so professional! Let's get started then, shall we?
All right, people! We're ready to get started!

I'm glad to see you taking this so seriously. So young, yet so professional! Let's get started then, shall we?
Great. All right, people! We're ready to get started!
Oh, and don't worry. I've already discussed your compensation with your agency.
Sawamura-san is here!
I'm Haruka Sawamura. Thank you for having me here today!
Ah, Sawamura-san! Thank you for coming!
That article we did on you was a real hit, so we decided to organize this handshake event for our readers.
I'm very glad to hear that! I look forward to meeting everyone.
Great! Lots of guests are already lined up outside. Shall we get started?
Oh, I almost forgot. Do you already know what goes on in a handshake event?

Does that all make sense?

Until next time!
Yes! I'll be looking forward to it!
Sawamura-san, that was good! The handshake event was a success!
We'll definitely have to write an article about this. The fans will be glad to see it!

I'm so sorry! I just couldn't seem to find my rhythm.
I know interacting with the fans isn't easy, but you have to be able to do better than that.
That's all right. Well, I guess we're done for today.
Okay. I really apologize.
Thank you for having me today!
Sawamura-san! It's great to see you!
Our articles about you never fail to be a hit with our readers. You're becoming one of our most featured idols!
Really? How exciting!
Well, shall we get started? You're all set on how the event's gonna go, right?
Actually, I could use a reminder, if you don't mind.
Okay, great. Let's get started!
You got 700 experience points.
Hello, Sawamura-san!
(There's no director here today, so I have to make sure I do a good job on my own.)

Great job, Sawamura-san!

(I'd say that was a success! I can't wait to do another event like this.)
Good job, Sawamura-san!
(I think I did okay today, but I know I could have done better.)
(Next time, I'll try even harder to make all of the fans happy.)
It's all right. It's over, Sawamura-san.

(What should I check?)

Hello, Uda-san. Thank you for inviting me here today.

I've really been looking forward to this dance event today.
Well, I'm still just a beginner when it comes to dancing, but I'm going to do my very best!
A beginner, huh? No matter, I'm sure you'll do great. Good luck today!
(I wonder if I should go over how the event works.)
(I've gone over it before, so I guess I don't really need to again. I'd better get ready.)
(Yes, I think I'd better. Just in case.)

In dance events, you dance alone instead of with an opponent.

Press the displayed buttons at the correct time to score points and fill the Performance Gauge, located at the top right of the screen.

Your objective is to completely fill the Performance Gauge through all four stages.
(Yep, I'm all set now. Better get started.)
Ah, Haruka-san. Thank you for the performance.

You made it look so fun, I couldn't help dancing a little myself.
Hehe. We should dance together next time!
Ah, I might take you up on that.

You got <Color:8>Iyemon Cha (Green Tea)<Color:Default>.
Oh, wow!
Haha. You look pleased.
Yes! Very!

You think so? I'm so glad!

Yes, I would like that very much!
It's settled!

Yes. I really apologize.
Hm. I just hope you can improve before we have our next event.

Oh, hello, Haruka-san. We've been waiting for you.
So, how's it going? Are you more used to dancing these days?
Not really. I still get super nervous!
You know, they say if you get stage fright, you should picture the audience naked.

What!? Oh, you're right! Haha, my mistake.
Haha! Now I don't feel as nervous anymore. Thank you!
Happy to help.
Well, off I go!
(I've done this kind of thing before, so I guess I don't need to. I'd better get started.)

Sawamura-san, hello!

Thank you for inviting me!

Wow, I'm impressed.
(Mmm. They look so yummy.)

Please! Take them home and enjoy at your leisure!
All right! Thank you very much!
(Chocolates from a famous shop! What a great day this turned out to be!)
The crowd was pretty into it. I'd say it was quite a success!

Don't mind if I do! Thanks!
Aren't you going to have some, Haruka-chan?
Oh, yes! Thank you very much!
(Mmm. It just melts in my mouth! I'm so glad I came today and got to try these wonderful chocolates!)
Actually, the crowd didn't really seem all that into it...

Heh, sorry about that! Will you forgive me if I tell you I brought you a little treat?
Oh, are you still here? You're all done, so you can go now.
Oh, all right. Thank you for having me.
Hello, Sawamura-san! You just let us know when you're ready!
I will! Thank you!
You've got about five minutes.
(I've done this kind of thing before, so I guess I don't need to. Better get started.)
Thank you, everyone!
(I felt like I stayed on beat better than usual this time. What a great feeling!)
(My body was able to keep up with what I was picturing in my mind for the most part. I think I did pretty well!)
Thank you everyone.
(No. That was awful. I can't believe I fell in the middle of my performance.)
(Hmm. I wonder if I should go over how the event works.)
Okay, this is the starting point here.
Yeah, yeah. Let's get this over with already.
Are you ready? You don't need me to explain everything, do you?
Maybe just briefly? I'm sorry, but I want to make sure I've got it.
Uuugh. I was hoping I wouldn't have to keep talking to you.
Whatever, you're new. I guess it can't be helped. Look, what I want is pretty straightforward, so listen up.
Yes, sir. I apologize for the trouble.

The goal of "Running Girl" is to get to the finish line within the time limit.
When you hear the signal, start running.

To run, follow the onscreen commands, alternately pressing <Action:Button_L1@Running_Girl> and <Action:Button_R1@Running_Girl>.

Try to press the correct button when it is highlighted onscreen. Time your button presses correctly, and your running speed will increase.

But remember, the faster you run, the faster you will have to alternate button presses to succeed.

If you don't reach the finish line within the time limit, you'll automatically be given the chance to retry.

The show can shoot up to three takes, so you will have three chances to reach the goal within the time allotted.
There. Get it now?
Yes, I understand. Thank you.
Great. Then let's start filming already!
Okay, everyone, we're ready to go!

All right, everyone, we're ready to go!
Sawamura-san! Over here, please.
Hey, you trying to jerk us around here!? Do you really think our viewers are gonna be satisfied with that sad fumble of a run you just did?
Oh! I know, it was horrible!
You got that right! That take was completely unusable. You'll have to run again.
I understand. I know I can do better.
Cut!

Now that's the kind of running I like to see!
